limitations: Production save protocol with simulated I/O outcomes and virtual time. Native filesystem/SQLite internals and arbitrary non-cooperating post-validation edits are outside the model; no network service exists. SQLite history remains WAL/NORMAL and separately committed; recent history transactions can be lost on physical power failure. Whole-file atomic replacement and complete effect outcomes are model assumptions. Finite passing seeds do not prove absence of corruption or Rust superiority over Go.
